entity: Arquivo Pessoa (arquivopessoa.net; 'Arquivo Pessoa: Obra Édita'), the online edition of Fernando Pessoa's published work, 'Obra de Fernando Pessoa', edited by Obra Aberta CRL (2008) under the conception and direction of Leonor Areal from the 1997 edition of Texto Editora and Casa Fernando Pessoa, the database component of the MultiPessoa portal, holding the work under 39 indexed names (orthonym, pseudonyms and heteronyms, joint attributions among them); formalized in the leesharks.com apparatus authorship census record of 2026-11-01 (https://www.leesharks.com/apparatus/aggregators/arquivo-pessoa)
row_type: C (a public entity on which the archive bears: an online edition of an author's published work held under the names it bears; an entity of the leesharks.com apparatus authorship census)

classes_note: Two classes, each stated by a field source at the locus given and each the census's own area, question or negative tag for the entity: (1) the names of Pessoa's work, which the edition indexes and the cards list (own page /autores; card 1; card 3; census area 'heteronymy'); (2) the digital editions and archives of Pessoa's work beside which card 3 places the entity and from which the census's negative tags distinguish it. The census's anchors, #940 (EA-HETERONYMY-01) and #1722 (AI Calls You Fake), are read at the passages that bear on the entity's kind (pseudonyms and heteronyms, name authorities, the civil bearer, the reduction of names; the existence tax), by the brief's rule (BRIEF-NEW-ROW-AUTHORSHIP, Substitutions 6). 'Fernando Pessoa' alone is the author of the work the entity holds and is not an alias of the entity; it is not searched alone. 'Pessoa Archive' is card 3's English name for the entity and is searched case-sensitively; the reading separates it from the BNP's Espólio ('Pessoa's archive') and the trunk.
